title: nbn service fault - Lochinvar South, NSW
current_summary:
The fault affects an internet service in Lochinvar South, NSW, and was logged at 2:41 pm AEDT on 15 November 2026. No restoration estimate has been provided yet.

nbn is investigating an alarm on a cell at a Fixed Wireless tower that has caused a loss of service. If the issue is unable to be corrected remotely, a field technician will be sent to the site to perform investigations. Updates will be provided as more information, or an ETA, becomes available.
